source.source_scope: Numeric v7 outcomes are copied from the completed training metrics and final or best checkpoint metadata, or are exact integer counts derived from recorded rates and denominators. The v6 comparison is copied from the hashed v6 failure report. The config and checkpoint metadata pin the requested native-boundary contract. The two implementation hashes describe the current post-run audited source, not the exact source already imported by the v7 MPS process; that loaded-source hash was not captured. No oracle scene artifact was read to generate this report.

oracle_scope.training: The scene-only warmup and per-batch spatial-answer contrastive objective used oracle target coordinates during training, as permitted supervision. Object labels, captions, scene descriptions, and oracle relationships were not supplied to the continuous inference prefix.
oracle_scope.report_generation: This evaluation-only report reads training metrics, checkpoint files, configuration, current post-run implementation files, and a prior evaluation report, not an oracle scene artifact.
oracle_scope.runtime_inference: Runtime inference was not exercised by this report, so this report makes no runtime oracle-isolation claim.

ordered_layout: remaining system and user prompt embeddings
native_boundary_protocol.boundary_checkpoint_contract: The checkpoint records native boundary mode and stores the native-boundary adapter state. The current post-run audited implementation requires BOI and EOI buffers to exactly equal scaled embeddings from the pinned loaded Gemma model; the exact loaded-source hash for the completed run is unavailable.
native_boundary_protocol.current_post_run_per_layer_embedding_pro: In the current audited implementation, BOI and EOI use their native token PLE identities and continuous latent slots use the native PAD-token PLE identity. This source snapshot postdates process start and is not proof of every implementation detail executed by v7.
native_boundary_protocol.current_post_run_multimodal_token_type_p: In the current audited implementation, BOI and EOI use modality type 0, all 256 continuous latent slots use modality type 1, and text uses modality type 0. The exact loaded source was not hashed.
native_boundary_protocol.protocol_limit: The recorded config and checkpoint establish the requested native boundary identities, but the exact source loaded by the already-running v7 process was not hashed. Current source includes post-run fixes, notably exact learned-PAD main embeddings for variable-length stacking and additional audit/resume validation; this report does not claim v7 executed those later fixes. Pair microbatches may have had equal lengths, but padding behavior for the run was not measured and no behavioral irrelevance is inferred. The contract also does not establish that learned 3D scene latents are distributionally equivalent to Gemma's native vision-token sequence.

stage_2_decoder_conditioned_pair_trainin.gradient_scaling: Each microbatch loss was divided by six before backward, so each optimizer update used the exact arithmetic mean of all six counterfactual-unit gradients.

warmup_outcome.interpretation_limit: This was a six-side scene-only spatial-alignment warmup pass, not a pass of the six-unit decoder-conditioned candidate-logit gate.

comparison_with_v6.controlled_config_change: v7 inherits v6 and replaces its learned scene-start/scene-end vectors with the exact frozen native Gemma BOI/EOI boundary protocol; the output namespace also changes.
comparison_with_v6.shared_recorded_conditions: Both runs used BOS-first layout, the same two training scenes, 12 questions, six counterfactual units, 256 scene latents, 72 decoder microsteps, gradient accumulation of six, 12 main optimizer updates, and the same scene-only warmup result.
comparison_with_v6.interpretation_limit: In these single deterministic runs, v7 improved several best and final aggregate gate measurements, but its final minimum margin was worse and neither run passed. No repeated-seed experiment was performed, so this comparison does not establish a statistically reliable causal benefit from native boundaries.

measured_findings: The config, selection report, final metadata, and best metadata all record BOS-first layout and scene_boundary_mode=gemma4_native_image with the same pinned native token contract.
The exact source hash loaded by the v7 MPS process was not captured; current native-boundary implementation hashes are a post-run audited snapshot.
The scene-only warmup passed 6/6 supervised sides at step 28 with minimum margin 0.105218805372715, above the 0.1 target.
The monitored best checkpoint was epoch 7 with 3/6 complete changed units, 9/12 correct sides, and hinge 0.314453125; it did not pass the gate.
The highest changed-unit result was 4/6 at epoch 3, but that epoch had hinge 0.7161458134651184 and minimum margin -3.59375, so it was not the best monitored checkpoint and still failed.
The gate was unstable across epochs: complete changed units fell from 4/6 at epoch 3 to 0/6 at epochs 5 and 6, recovered to 3/6 at epoch 7, fell to 0/6 at epoch 9, and ended at 3/6.
The final epoch had 3/6 complete units, 9/12 correct sides, 3/6 prediction flips, 3/6 wrong-prefix flips, mean margin 0.3644205629825592, minimum margin -1.484375, and hinge 0.3860677182674408.
The final training loss was 16.96178976694743; the lowest epoch-average training loss was 15.412305990854898 at epoch 8, which was not the best gate checkpoint.
diagnosis.evidence_supported_inference: Native boundary identities were not sufficient to make the frozen Gemma decoder reliably bind all six changed facts to the continuous scene prefix under this optimization budget.
diagnosis.causal_claim_limit: The v6-to-v7 comparison has one run per protocol and no repeated seeds. Numeric differences are descriptive, not a causal or statistical result.
diagnosis.detail_limit: The completed v7 run predates integration of the per-unit candidate-gate detail artifact, so the aggregate metrics do not identify which opaque question units failed at each epoch.
diagnosis.source_provenance_limit: The run had imported an earlier source snapshot before post-run native-boundary fixes were applied. Exact learned-PAD main-embedding behavior for any variable-length stacking in that process, plus later audit/resume validation, cannot be attributed to v7 from the available artifacts.

claim_limits.valid_claim: v7 was configured and checkpointed for the native Gemma image-boundary protocol, made measurable but unstable teacher-forced progress, and failed its small two-scene training wiring gate; the exact source already loaded by the process was not captured.
invalid_claims: execution of post-run padding, audit, or resume fixes
bitwise reconstruction of the source loaded by the v7 process
statistically established causal benefit from native boundaries
